en: A black‑and‑white street scene showing a cobblestone road with tram tracks, lined by tall brick and stone buildings. On the left are many statues mounted on the facade of a large historic building; on the right are shopfronts with awnings. Numerous pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing and cyclists move along the street. In the distance stands a prominent historic tower and building complex in the town square. The caption at the bottom reads "Nijmegen. Korte Burchtstraat."
